quests.title: Trace TNF
quests.prompt: Find a gene that appears across immune, inflammatory, and metabolic disease packets.
quests.reward: 9 genes appear in at least three disease packets.

quests.title: Inspect a treatment
quests.prompt: Open Methotrexate, then follow its treatment and class evidence.
quests.reward: 31 drugs currently connect to more than one disease packet.

quests.title: Switch on expression
quests.prompt: Use Evidence to view upregulated and downregulated gene claims for one disease.
quests.reward: Expression claims carry numeric log2 fold-change values where available.

quests.prompt: Open Sources to jump from claims to source datasets, papers, and identifiers.
quests.reward: The graph is organized so claims stay traceable back to source material.
